rationale: Jamie is building agentic AI to automate repetitive construction work at scale, while Jwalin is exploring privacy-preserving local-first AI systems on consumer hardware—complementary approaches to making AI practical. Jamie's conviction that AI agents should handle project delivery work pairs well with Jwalin's expertise in ML infrastructure, small language models, and privacy-first architectures, which could inform how Mastt's agents operate efficiently and securely. Both are in San Francisco and focused on solving real problems with AI rather than chasing hype.
intro_message: Jamie Cerexhe, meet Jwalin Shah — you're both building pragmatic AI systems (agentic automation for construction vs. privacy-preserving local AI), and your complementary technical backgrounds in ML infrastructure and autonomous systems could spark useful conversation.
